tasks.label: asm32
tasks.command: cd "${fileDirname}"; ext="${file##*.}"; outname="${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; for f in *."$ext"; do [ -f "$f" ] && nasm -F dwarf -g -f elf32 -i . -o "${f%.*}.o" "$f"; done; ld -m elf_i386 -o "$outname.exe" *.o

tasks.label: asm64
tasks.command: cd "${fileDirname}"; ext="${file##*.}"; outname="${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; for f in *."$ext"; do [ -f "$f" ] && nasm -F dwarf -g -f elf64 -i . -o "${f%.*}.o" "$f"; done; ld -m elf_x86_64 -o "$outname.exe" *.o

tasks.label: gas
tasks.command: cd "${fileDirname}"; ext="${file##*.}"; outname="${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; for f in *."$ext"; do [ -f "$f" ] && as --32 --gstabs+ "$f" -o "${f%.*}.o"; done; ld -m elf_i386 -o "$outname.exe" *.o

tasks.label: asm64+gcc
